Test fixtures from PlanNH's test resources (WO-3.4, D192)

light_fuel_hydrogen_loop.yaml and 230_platline.yaml are copied unchanged from
https://github.com/GTNewHorizons/PlanNH, src/test/resources/gtnh-flow/, at commit
6506cdc035149e3545e3414eccbde6ecaa1b52a8 (2026-11-09). They are gtnh-flow charts
(https://github.com/OrderedSet86/gtnh-flow, MIT, Copyright (c) 2022 OrderedSet86).
PlanNH's ground truth (GroundTruthTest.java, [E§3.2]): the platline solves with every
machine running and at most 2 externals; the light-fuel loop closes with 0 gates.

They are test data only; nothing in core/ reads them. PlanNH's licence follows.
